About This Fan Project

Hogwarts: Houses & Wizards is an educational fan experience that curates lore-friendly summaries, timelines, and data-driven interactions. Every page was assembled exclusively with AI-authored code prompts—no manual edits.

Project Overview

This site re-imagines the classic Hogwarts information guide as a modern, accessible, multi-page destination. It emphasizes dark-mode aesthetics, responsive layouts, and interactive filters for exploring house traits, notable alumni, and milestone events.

Credits & Attribution

Typography is powered by the Google Fonts families Cinzel Decorative and Inter. Icons and imagery are lightweight, AI-generated placeholders exported as efficient WebP assets. Design inspiration draws from official Wizarding World branding while honoring fair-use principles.

Sparkle accents were custom-built in SVG. No third-party JS frameworks or build pipelines were used—only semantic HTML, modern CSS, and plain JavaScript.
